terra.problem: A plan to spend a year there does not establish that the planners won't settle there permanently.
The passage does not say the planners will work without resting or taking a nap.
The comparison mentions coffee, which is not a permitted food or drink in a joke.
‘Near’ and ‘willing’ are not close in sound.
The dirty mixing bowl treats an ordinary cleaning task as an example of sin, which the passage does not establish.
The verse doesn't say nobody broke in or that the clothes were eaten where they were stored.
The verse doesn't mention weather, but that doesn't establish that there was no storm.
James doesn't say how long the treasure was kept or that the length of storage caused the corrosion.
James doesn't say the corroded gold cannot help anyone pay anything.
Withheld wages don't establish that the pay never arrived, and the passage doesn't specify a day's work.
James doesn't say the workers had their tools.
James says the harvesters' cries reached the Lord; the claim that nobody's voice gets lost extends beyond what this passage says.
The passage doesn't say that hardship belonged only to the workers and not to those living in luxury.
Luxury and self-indulgence don't establish that the rich people's lives were not quiet.
